items.title: Chemical traces of blood found in a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone
items.tldr: A team led by Curtin University reports red blood cell-like structures and heme molecules inside the leg bone of a 115-million-year-old Brazilian dinosaur, the first chemical evidence of blood in a dinosaur.

items.title: LHCb sees first evidence of the rarest beauty-particle decay yet observed
items.tldr: The upgraded LHCb experiment at CERN reports 3.2-sigma evidence for a beauty-particle decay into two muons that occurs about once per ten billion decays, consistent with the Standard Model.

items.title: Perioperative ivonescimab with or without chemotherapy in resectable non-small cell lung cancer: a phase 2 trial
items.tldr: In a 90-patient phase 2 trial, ivonescimab plus chemotherapy before and after surgery gave a 70.1% major pathological response in resectable lung cancer.
items.byline: Xiaoliang Zhao, Bin Zhang, Chenguang Li et al. · Tianjin Medical University Cancer Institute and Hospital, The Fourth Hospital of Hebei Medical University

items.title: An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations
items.tldr: AutoDNA, an AI-run laboratory, coordinates over 20 instruments across more than 11,000 steps to carry out DNA synthesis, amplification and sequencing with minimal human intervention.
items.byline: Mingyu Wu, Zhaoguo Wang, Jiabin Wang et al.

items.title: Carbon radical generation by irreversible metal-to-ligand charge transfer
items.tldr: Copper complexes of heteroaryl sulfones split apart when hit by visible light, releasing carbon radicals that enable fluoroalkylation of arenes and alkynes.
items.byline: Zhiqiang Wei, Xiang Li, Lin Xiao et al. · Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, ShanghaiTech University
